header104.label: ObjectBehavior header104 / compact Rc request candidate
header104.source_state: final release-ready binary; full source verification and required validation completed

intl63f2.label: older accepted compact-Intl baseline built from 63f2

build: Release opt-level3, fatLTO, one codegen unit, panic=abort, default intl+embed, ARM64 template JIT; optimizing tier and diagnostic instrumentation off during timings. Rust1.99.0 b940084d7/LLVM23.1.1. CPU5.

policy.threshold: Per component: paired median loss >3% AND95% interval wholly slower. Both A/A directions checked independently. No normalized/subtracted A/A.
policy.samples: Application comparisons:6 balanced fresh-process pairs. Original startup A/A:60 pairs. Fixed confirmation and final startup comparisons:600 raw pairs,60 disjoint groups of10.
policy.startup_cpu: User/system CPU ratios use sums of10 raw observations per role per group to resolve zero-valued millisecond readings. Wall/childwall/RSS remain600 raw paired ratios. Same10000-resample bootstrap and fixed metric seed.
policy.container_correction: An empty internal_by_kernel_median_ms object is a container, not a missing required scalar. Reassessment deep-copied original data; real flags and zero observations retained.
policy.original_vs_confirmation: Original failed startup controls remain recorded. One fixed resolution confirmation for every artifact passes. Six-pair EJS controls show no asymmetry under this rule; not proof of equivalence.
policy.screen_stop: All three candidates fail the component regression gate. No remaining Intl/control acceptance matrix or production integration is warranted; no candidate source is applied.
policy.interruption_handling: Two externally interrupted header104 application screens are wholly excluded from acceptance and retained. Final complete replacement uses the same binary, fixture, sample counts and gates under renewed user coordination.
